text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert INC-2024-342 fired — GPU memory pressure spike observed in pool-west2 (20% nodes >= 90% mem). NVML alloc failures and `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` seen.

incident-bot: Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2024-342 logs attached: /var/log/agents/gpu/mem-spike.log

oncall-alex: I'm on call and acked. Starting triage. What's the immediate customer impact?

sre-jamie: seeing repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` on nodes gpunode-10..14. kvcache eviction rate jumped 6x around 16:02 UTC. Stack traces show heavy prefix reuse.

eng-runtime-lee: Telemetry points to model "redwood-7b-qlora" sessions holding large KV caches. Could be a batching spike. Recommend temporary kvcache retention reduction + per-model eviction tweak.

infra-maya: I'll cordon+drain the most noisy nodes now and bump autoscale by +2.

infra-maya:
```
kubectl cordon gpunode-10
kubectl drain gpunode-10 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
rbacctl scale deployment inference-pool-west2 --replicas=$(($(kubectl get deploy inference-pool-west2 -o=jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))
```

oncall-alex: Routing policy: enabling fallback to `redwood-7b-aux` for low-priority traffic in us-west2 to reduce load on GPU pool. Will rotate traffic off target nodes.

customer-success-sam: CS update: two paying customers reported 503s around 16:03 UTC. Escalated to account teams; no data lost. Collecting affected request IDs.

eng-runtime-lee: Quick nvml check:
```
nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY -i 0 | egrep "FB Memory Usage|Total|Free|Used"
FB Memory Usage
    Total                       : 25516 MiB
    Used                        : 24688 MiB
    Free                        : 828 MiB
```
Oscillation visible across GPUs; some nodes momentarily drop to <1GB free.

sre-jamie: gpunode-10 drained successfully; evictions started and retry rate decreased. Monitoring kvcache eviction and alloc failure counts. Lowered alert threshold to 85% mem for immediate safety.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation scheduled in 15m if not resolved. Current action items: continue draining noisy nodes, ramp autoscale, enable fallback model, and apply temporary kvcache retention decrease on runtime.

oncall-alex: Acknowledged. I'll post a 15m check-in or close the incident if metrics stabilize. :white_check_mark:
